evidence.title: Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees

summary: Researchers have introduced a primal‑dual alternating neural learning framework that speeds up time‑critical classification tasks while providing provable performance guarantees. The approach outperforms existing models on benchmark datasets and offers theoretical bounds on accuracy and latency.
title: New Primal-Dual Alternating Neural Learning Method Enables Fast, Guaranteed-Performance Classification
